author: ne valley times
title: Derren Thompson named senior vice president at Western State Bank Scottsdale
text:
Derren Thompson has joined Western State Bank as Senior Vice President and Commercial Banking Officer at its Scottsdale, Arizona location. In his new role, Thompson will focus on commercial business development and work with business customers to provide financing solutions.
Thompson brings more than 35 years of banking experience to the bank. He holds a Bachelor of Science degree in finance from the University of Utah. He is involved in the community as a member of the Arizona Commercial Mortgage Lenders Association and volunteers with organizations such as Rosie’s House, JDRF, Pop Warner Football, and Little League Baseball.
Originally from Sandy, Utah, Thompson now lives in Scottsdale with his wife. They have three adult children.
Western State Bank was founded in 1902 and is an employee-owned community bank with assets totaling over $2 billion. The bank provides a range of services including full-banking services, investments, mortgage financing for personal and business customers, as well as nationwide equipment financing. Western State Bank operates locations in North Dakota communities such as West Fargo, Fargo, and Devils Lake, along with several branches across Arizona including Casa Grande, Chandler, Deer Valley, Mesa, Scottsdale, Sun City, and Sun City West.
For additional information about this announcement or Western State Bank’s services contact Anna Benson at Western State Bank by phone at 701-499-6259 or by email at Anna.benson@westernbanks.com.
